oracle.scope: Actual pefile export parser and unmodified pinned ExportSymbolFinder on PE32/PE32+ mapped bytes

corpus.comparison: All ordered native entries and exact lookups match; every acquisition independently reread directly from original kernel memory

limitations: Supporting parser only; no new plugin acceptance
Forwarders retained as metadata, not recursively resolved
Strict malformed-input failures differ from pefile silent skips
Raw names preserve bytes; no pefile display-name validity heuristic
Real PE32 and forwarded-export corpora pending
Full architecture/version/corruption and PE extension acceptance pending
